_about: Field limits read by scripts/listing.py. Every value was written from memory on the date shown and is unverified: open the store's own documentation named in 'source' and correct the value before submitting. Keys ending in _max_chars limit the field of that name; characters are counted as Unicode code points. screenshots_min and screenshots_max count the screenshots list (per device size in the stores' own rules; this file holds one number for the list as given).

required_fields.unit: listing fields that cannot be empty
required_fields.note: description, keywords and screenshots: 'This property is required' on that page; name: Required in https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/reference/app-information/required-localizable-and-editable-properties. Apple also requires a Support URL, which this listing format does not hold

name_max_chars.note: the name must also be at least two characters

keywords_max_chars.note: Apple states the limit as 100 bytes, not characters; non-ASCII keywords use more than one byte per character, so a character count can pass a field Apple rejects

required_fields.unit: listing fields that cannot be empty
required_fields.note: 'You must provide a minimum of two screenshots' and a feature graphic to publish (answer 9866151); app name, short description and full description are the App details fields of the store listing (answer 9859152). The feature graphic, app icon and contact email are also required but are not fields in this listing format

screenshots_min.note: at least two screenshots across device types to publish

screenshots_max.note: up to 8 per supported device type
